event_definitions.name: ls_mab_alloc.loads
event_definitions.label: L1 load MAB allocations
event_definitions.meaning: Load miss-address-buffer allocations; request/allocation evidence, not retired-load misses.

event_definitions.name: l2_cache_req_stat.ls_rd_blk_c
event_definitions.label: L2 data-cache request misses
event_definitions.meaning: Core-to-L2 data-cache request misses, all types, excluding L2 prefetch. Includes more than retired demand loads.

event_definitions.name: ls_refills_from_sys.ls_mabresp_lcl_dram
event_definitions.label: Local DRAM/IO demand fills
event_definitions.meaning: Demand data-cache fills from DRAM or IO on this thread die. Indirect beyond-cache evidence, not a direct L3 miss count.

event_definitions.name: ls_dispatch.ld_dispatch
event_definitions.label: Load dispatches
event_definitions.meaning: Dispatched load operations including helper/stack work and speculative activity; not retired loads.
